$comment: ADR-337: claim-and-build for unhired AI humans (ai/claim_build.ts). An unhired bot with no home and met survival needs claims land instead of wandering: it repairs/rebuilds the nearest mostly-intact abandoned ruin, or plants a Claim Flag and builds a 2x2 hut of its own design. Thresholds are data so tuning never touches code. scanRadius mirrors ABANDONED_SCAN_RADIUS (building/abandoned.ts). ruinPreferDist: a suitable ruin at or inside this distance wins over building new. minIntact: a ruin needs at least this fraction of its planned structural pieces still standing to be worth claiming (below it the bot builds new). maxDamagedFrac: a ruin whose standing structural pieces are mostly damaged (hp below repairHpFrac) is too ruined even when intact. repairHpFrac matches the repair sensor's 60% rule (ai/autonomy.ts). needs: the bot only claims when hunger/thirst/bodyTemp are at or above these (same cutoffs autonomy uses for hungry/thirsty/cold). claimAbandonDist: a claim target farther than this from the bot is dropped (relocation, respawn far away). variants: deterministic per-bot hut layouts — same pieces, same costs, just a layout variant; extra offsets are relative to the hut anchor (the north-west foundation corner). garden beds and the workbench ride the planner's normal item goals for their materials (planks need a workbench, so garden extras only become buildable once the planner has built one); fence_rail/rope is hand-crafted.
